title: This is great!
body: Have been looking for a good habit tracker for a while now and this has been the best one I've found so far. Thank you!
author: bashang99

title: So nice and simple!
body:
Such a simple app to use. If you could add a feature please let us arrange the order of habits. And have lightmode on. Also please add more icons. Thanks so much!

update: I think the recent update about sync made my habits disappear, is there anyway I can get them back??
author: dubaichocomochi

title: Great Habit Tracker
body:
Best that I have tried so far. Great Widgets Included. Very easy to use! 

Would however be very cool to get reminders to log your habits, ability to set habits that are once a week, once a month.
author: Pent4gr4m
